flags.message: Forward-mode retrieval used material later than the arrival-position baseline: the live supremecourt.gov docket for 26A370 shows Justice Kagan requesting a response on 2026-09-18 and the respondents' opposition filed on 2026-09-25, and I read that opposition. Both entries also appear as sibling event definitions in this case directory. The application was undecided at retrieval (no referral entry, no amicus, no disposition). The response-requested-increment claim is stated at 0.99 because the rung has already fired; the harness should resolve it as vacuous against the frozen context (response_requested: false).

The provisioned application.txt is marked truncated (189 pages). The cut fell inside the appendix, after the Ninth Circuit's Sept 1, 2026 order; the full argument section was readable. No prediction impact.

Corpus prior pool for the interim anchor: Terms 2024 and 2025 only (31 granted / 296 resolved = 10.5%), Term 2024 being 75% unparsed. The pool clears the 50-resolved floor but rests on two Terms with very different coverage and rates (20.0% vs 7.5%).
